Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook Account Briefly Suspended

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook account was temporarily suspended, making his page with over 9 million followers unavailable for approximately 90 minutes. The suspension caused concern among his supporters. The reason for the unavailability was not immediately clear, with speculation ranging from technical issues to other causes.
